name: git commit
purpose: Record staged changes permanently as a snapshot in Git history.
explanation: Step 4 (Record) of the Git workflow. Saves the staged snapshot with a descriptive message explaining what changed and why.

parameters.description: Inline commit message describing what and why.

example: git commit -m "Add student registration form validation"
whenToUse: After staging changes with git add to save a checkpoint.
commonMistakes: Writing vague commit messages like 'updated file' or 'fixed stuff'.
Forgetting -m and getting dropped into a terminal text editor.
